title: How We Built a C11 + Solidity EVM Precompile ZK-Accumulator (Under The Hood)
short_title: The EVM Precompile Bug That Almost Slipped Past CI 🤯 #shorts #ethereum
description:
In this deep dive, we walk through the architecture of Aegis ZK-Accumulator: a high-performance Sparse Merkle Tree engine written in C11 paired with an EVM precompile shim and Solidity 0.8.37 accumulator contract.

We cover:
00:00 - The EVM Gas Problem with Sparse Merkle Trees
01:30 - C11 SMT-256 Bitwise Traversal & O(1) Zero Pruning
03:15 - Precompile Calldata ABI Encoding (Address 0x09)
05:00 - Post-Mortem: The uint256 Calldata Downcast Vulnerability
07:20 - Solidity Vault & Accumulator Invariant Testing in Foundry
09:10 - Live Benchmarks (0.42 μs vs 1,130 Gas)
10:45 - Open Source Repo Walkthrough & CI Setup

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/basantzp/aegis-zk-accumulator
License: MIT
Language Stats: 100% C & Solidity
